Since the pool sits at 2000, above the 1000 threshold, I'm only caught if it drops to 1000 or below by the end of the day, which would cost half my points. Today's nine safe kills at 4x already give 36 points. Hitting the forum victims would add another 8, but it brings more risk, since L randomly traces about five deaths a day. With the pool having stayed at 2000 through many traces, I'm weighing whether the extra kills are worth it

I'm settling on whether the forum kills are worth the risk: the extra 8 points isn't enough to justify a chance at losing half my total, so I'm skipping them. The remaining plan is to kill the nine safe criminals in the morning, since nothing else would change the outcome.
